name: icons
useFor: Use these where Figma draws them: ArrowRightIcon after a key's label (its `head` turned 90 degrees is the select chevron), CheckIcon in the checkbox, PlusIcon for add (turned 45 degrees it closes), ParcelIcon before coordinates. For everything else use Phosphor at regular weight. Sizes are Figma's; they render at the product scale.
constraints: Mixing these with a filled Phosphor weight
A chevron icon where the arrow head serves
source: Figma UI boards: buttons 442:3, checkbox 442:161, search field 442:141
title: Icons
description: Mireye's own glyphs from Figma: the arrow (and its head alone), the check, the plus and the parcel.
